finalText:
**Migration done.** I moved 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Every file parses under `node --check`. A repo-wide grep now finds no `db.query` outside `vendor`.

| Left alone | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | Header says do not edit. Upgrades wipe local changes. |
| `cache.query` in 20 files | Different object. Not part of this. |

Next move is yours on `vendor`. Upstream `legacy-orm` has to fix it, or you shim `db.query`.
